description: Defines a class `Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_DqContent` used within the Smarty templating engine to represent raw characters in double-quoted strings during template parsing.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_DqContent
classes.description: Represents raw characters as part of a double-quoted string in the Smarty template parse tree.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parse tree node with string content.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Converts the parse tree node back into a PHP double-quoted string literal.
